purpose: Acquire a new genuine EUR/USD bid/ask tick dataset for local, non-redistributed quantitative research; no strategy execution is authorized by this plan.

target.date_selection_basis: The two most recent complete calendar years preceding the current UTC year (2026), fixed before any performance inspection.

pilot.selection_basis: The first fixed six-hour interval inside the declared target, not a return- or trade-selected interval.

provider.name: Dukascopy Bank SA datafeed
endpoint_notes: The official data-export documentation describes compressed .bi5 tick artifacts and a Requester Pays S3 workflow.
The legacy HTTP template is retained as a candidate only; it was not probed or downloaded.
A downloader release is not a provider data revision. These identities remain separate.

downloader.name: dukascopy-node
downloader.tooling_identity: Public downloader package; not provider revision
downloader.reason_not_installed: Rights and zero-cost access gates failed before market-content acquisition.

raw_format.timestamp_semantics: Integer Unix epoch milliseconds interpreted as UTC; M15 bars use UTC bar-start flooring.
raw_format.price_semantics: EUR/USD bid and ask prices; provider point scaling must be verified before conversion.
raw_format.volume_semantics: Separate ask and bid volumes; source units must be recorded and not inferred as traded volume.
raw_format.quote_requirement: Both bid and ask observations are required; bid-only bars are not admissible for this path.
raw_format.conversion_lineage: Preserve native provider bytes, hash them, then hash any versioned conversion separately before admission.

terms_and_use.intended_use: Local, non-commercial, non-redistributed quantitative research only.
blockers: The public data-export page documents a Requester Pays S3 path; using it may incur a charge, which is outside the zero-monetary-cost authorization.

The official Dukascopy Europe terms prohibit automated acquisition/database construction without prior express written consent. Applicability of that term to the exact public raw-tick endpoint is not resolved.
The official XML data agreement is a registration/approval license for XML data and does not establish permission for this raw bid/ask tick acquisition.
No provider grant expressly authorizing this exact automated raw-tick workflow was supplied.

resource_limits.stop_behavior: Preserve verified segments and emit BLOCKED_ACQUISITION_INCOMPLETE if a budget expires; never call a partial collection complete.

completion_criteria: Provider rights for this exact endpoint and local use are documented and applicable.
No charge is incurred, or the operator separately authorizes a cost; this plan itself authorizes zero cost only.
The complete fixed coverage is represented by successful per-segment records.
Every native artifact has byte size, SHA-256, endpoint, retrieval timestamp, HTTP/result status, and retry history.
Every conversion has an immutable converter identity and a hash relationship to native bytes.
The repository tick-admission path passes with zero unresolved quality blockers and a persisted license reference.
Only after those gates pass may a new dataset qualification and a new bound protocol be created.

source_identity.source_snapshot_scope: Current supported source snapshot excluding raw market data, caches, environment secrets, and research result data; includes current working-tree implementation and required untracked source files.
